meta.defaultDescription: ICC Online, the digital campus of Impact Centre Chrétien. A connected family to live faith, prayer and community wherever you are.

home.heroSubtitle: Discover our vision and programs by joining a dynamic, committed community.
home.familyText: Impact Centre Chrétien Online is the digital dimension of the Impact Centre Chrétien churches. A campus in its own right, ICC ONLINE brings together everyone who wants to belong to the Impact Centre Chrétien family but has no physical campus nearby.
home.joinText: Are you far from a physical ICC campus? Would you like to share your faith, discuss online services, be supported in prayer and encouraged in your walk? Do you want to understand the Bible better and discover God’s plans for your life? Then FIOs (Online Impact Families) are for you.

about.title: About ICC Online
about.p1: Impact Centre Chrétien Online is the digital dimension of the Impact Centre Chrétien churches. A campus in its own right, ICC ONLINE brings together everyone who wants to belong to the Impact Centre Chrétien family but has no physical campus nearby.
about.p2: Our vision: to offer a warm space to share faith, follow services, grow in the Word, pray together and encourage one another — wherever you are in the world.
about.p3After: are the heart of this community: small groups for fellowship, support and daily impact.
